description: Unit tests for the UniqueVector class, testing methods like push_back, emplace_back, push_back with index, and release functionality.

classes.name: UniqueVector
classes.description: A custom vector class that enforces uniqueness of elements, with methods for adding, checking, and retrieving elements.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the vector if it is not already present.

methods.name: emplace_back
methods.description: Constructs and adds an element to the vector if it is not already present.

methods.name: PushBackWithIndex
methods.description: Adds an element and returns a pair indicating if it was added and its index.

methods.name: EmplaceBackWithIndex
methods.description: Constructs and adds an element, returning a pair with addition status and index.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the internal vector, returning the elements and clearing the container.
